verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents one part of this story: a 'Secure Cloud' tier whose machines it says are verified to be in datacenters with a Tier 2/3 rating or ISO 27001, recommended for production. Nothing in the pack shows a SOC 2 report, a data-handling or privacy policy, or a trust/compliance center a platform engineer could review. A community report of a host misrepresenting its location undercuts listing accuracy, but it is not shown to involve Secure Cloud machines, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation, documented data-handling/retention and isolation guarantees, a provider-level compliance portal or audit reports, and independent verification of the datacenter-tier claims.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it

citations.quote: Vast verifies that these machines are in a datacenter with a TIER 2/3 rating or ISO 27001. These offer cards have a blue label and are recommended for production
Secure Cloud (Datacenter): These machines are verified and confirmed to be in a certified datacenter that meets our datacenter criteria.
